Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations

Class FileMigrationLock

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations.FileMigrationLock
All Implemented Interfaces:
MigrationLock
public final class FileMigrationLock extends Object implements MigrationLock
Keeps two processes from migrating one file-based database at the same time, with an operating system lock on a file beside the database.

The lock file is the database file's name with .migrate.lock added, in the same folder, which must exist and be writable. The lock belongs to the process that took it, so the system frees it when the process dies. The file itself is never deleted: it is empty, and removing it could race with a process that has just opened it. Inside one JVM a lock on the same file, reached through any path or symbolic link, waits for the first one, even on the same thread. Network file systems may ignore file locks; the lock then protects nothing.

The database path is asked for when acquire() runs, not when the lock is created, so a database that is opened lazily can be named. The lock uses java.io and FileChannel only, so it works on Android.

An instance holds the lock for one caller at a time: a second acquire() on the same instance while it is held fails at once. Separate instances on one database file queue instead.
